children: Britain's Reform UK has received a second £36 million($48.8 million) donation, the Telegraph newspaper reported on Saturday, in a major financial boost for Nigel Farage's party as it prepares for the next general election.

The newspaper said cryptocurrency billionaire Christopher Harborne, already Reform UK's biggest donor, had matched a record £36 million donation announced on Friday by fellow crypto investor Ben Delo, recently pardoned by U.S. President Donald Trump.
